findings.namedBuyers: Two verified commercially relevant local organisers, neither proven to control contracts: Dace Picot-Stiebrina (EPFL directory: Dace Stiebrina), EPS 2027 Local Organising Committee member and Administrative Assistant, SPC–Administration; dace.stiebrina@epfl.ch, +41 21 693 76 60. Appropriate first approach for logistics and referral to the accommodation decision-maker. Yves Martin, EPS 2027 Local Organising Committee member, identified as LOC chair in EPS-PPD minutes and Member of the Direction, SPC–Administration; yves.martin@epfl.ch, +41 21 693 65 11. Relevant senior organiser who specifically discussed venue arrangements and investigating student accommodation. General conference channel: epsplasma2027@epfl.ch. No named housing manager, external PCO or authorized hotel-contract signatory was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Officially confirmed upcoming edition: 53rd EPS Conference on Plasma Physics, 5–9 July 2027. EPFL Indico specifies 5 July 08:00 to 9 July 13:00, Europe/Zurich. These are conference activity dates, not announcement dates, and fall within the requested horizon. The official website says registration opens 15 March 2027. The 2028 host/location is announced as Laboratori Nazionali del Sud, Taormina, Italy, but no exact dates or selected venue were verified; do not create a dated 2028 opportunity.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel specification: weak geographic fit for main conference housing and unsuitable as a replacement plenary venue. YOTEL is in Founex, whereas the event is on the EPFL campus in Ecublens. The published planning model uses an 800-seat extendable plenary hall and parallel rooms, versus the supplied approximately 250-theatre maximum at YOTEL. The 650–700 published figure is the organisers’ estimated financial break-even threshold, NOT a delegate forecast or room requirement. Airport relevance is evidenced: EPS-PPD minutes say "There is a train service from Geneva Airport to Lausanne, and a Metro service from the centre of Lausanne to the venue"; the venue’s linked access page also describes Geneva Airport access. This establishes an airport route, not actual flight bookings or lodging toward La Côte. No evidence was found of delegates being directed to Founex, Nyon, La Côte or Geneva hotels. Only conditional pre/post-flight stays, a small independently booking delegation or an explicitly requested satellite meeting merits discussion. Any 20–120-room proposal would be a sales test based on the supplied guidance, not published demand. No restaurant/banquet capacity, shuttle service or travel time from YOTEL is assumed.
findings.venueCommitments: SwissTech Convention Center, Quartier Nord EPFL, Route Louis-Favre 2, 1024 Ecublens, Vaud, Switzerland; marketed by the conference as Lausanne. Territory classification: Lausanne / EPFL campus, not Founex, Nyon, La Côte or the Geneva Airport corridor. Official conference information confirms the venue. EPS-PPD board minutes explicitly state: "The venue, which has now been booked, will be the SwissTech Convention Center". This is a convention-centre commitment, not a hotel or accommodation commitment. The minutes PDF has inconsistent dating metadata/header relative to its file path and historical context; use its planning statements with that provenance caveat, not its header as an event date.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified annual international rotation: Salamanca, Spain, 8–12 July 2024, Palacio de Congresos; Vilnius, Lithuania, 7–11 July 2025, Radisson Blu Hotel Lietuva; Edinburgh, UK, 29 June–3 July 2026, Edinburgh International Conference Centre; Lausanne / Ecublens, Switzerland, 5–9 July 2027, SwissTech Convention Center. Taormina, Italy, is announced for 2028 with exact dates and selected venue unverified. Radisson Blu Lietuva was the 2025 conference venue in Lithuania, not evidence of a Lausanne Radisson commitment or recurring hotel-chain demand.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging mechanism remains unknown: no edition-specific hotel list, room allotment, booking portal, housing bureau, PCO or open RFP was found in the official material reviewed. Accordingly there are no verified 2027 committed hotels to enumerate. Indico says: "For other information (travel, accommodation, lunches, social activities, ...) please visit the conference website." Board minutes provide actual accommodation-planning evidence: "the target room rate is €100 – €120 per night"; the LOC was advised to keep accommodation costs down and Yves Martin said he would investigate cheap student housing. These are planning targets/enquiries, not negotiated rates, confirmed inventory or proof that sourcing remains open in November 2026. The SwissTech venue separately promotes SwissTech Hotel generically; that 2020 page is not an EPS 2027 booking commitment. An ENEA hotel page mentioning the 2027 programme committee concerns a separate 30 November–1 December 2026 meeting in Frascati, not Lausanne conference housing.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-led scientific conference held under the auspices of the European Physical Society, with local organisation by EPFL / Swiss Plasma Center. Distinguish EPS / its Plasma Physics Division (series governance), EPFL / SPC and its LOC (local organisation), and SwissTech Convention Center (booked venue). No evidence identifies SwissTech as the accommodation buyer or an external agency/PCO/DMC as the housing contractor.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The main venue is already booked elsewhere. SwissTech Hotel has a documented proximity advantage: the venue’s generic French page describes it as 50 metres from the convention centre; this is not evidence of an EPS 2027 room block, exclusivity or sell-out. The historical Radisson Blu Hotel Lietuva commitment belongs to Vilnius 2025 only. Cost pressure is explicit in the €100–€120 nightly planning target and student-housing enquiry; compatibility with YOTEL’s actual July 2027 rate is unverified. No sourced shortage, overflow allocation, competitor occupancy, centrally contracted housing arrangement or released hotel inventory was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send one qualification-led approach to Dace Picot-Stiebrina, copying Yves Martin or epsplasma2027@epfl.ch. State that YOTEL is in Founex, not Lausanne. Ask who handles EPS 2027 accommodation, whether delegates book independently or through allocated inventory, what hotels/student residences are committed, whether the €100–€120 planning target still applies, and whether any identified group requires airport-side pre/post nights or expressly accepts the Founex commute. Request group size, actual peak nights/rooms, transport arrangements and decision deadline before pricing. Offer no block or shuttle promise yet. If interest is confirmed, test a bounded room allocation within the supplied 20–120-room guidance, subject to availability/rate and actual demand. Otherwise close the 2027 lodging path and retain only permission-based EPFL/SPC meeting relationship development; do not assume annual Lausanne recurrence.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, the conference venue is committed; lodging accessibility remains unconfirmed. Absence of a published hotel block does not establish independent booking or open sourcing. Registration is scheduled to open 15 March 2027. The event-specific airport-travel discussion provides a legitimate but insufficient basis for a Founex ancillary-stay enquiry; there is no verified lodging pathway toward La Côte and no basis to claim primary conference housing.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: The annual conference rotates internationally; recurrence does not mean Lausanne demand repeats annually. Official EPS-PPD reporting identifies Taormina, Italy, for 2028, with no exact date or named venue verified. Future capture at YOTEL should therefore mean an expressly identified EPFL/SPC workshop, delegation stay or airport-linked ancillary requirement, not a forecast return of the main EPS conference or displacement of the booked SwissTech venue. This is a relationship-development strategy, not a verified future lead.
